title: Aunt Carol's Apple Pie
description: Aunt Carol's apple pie recipe is a favorite that's best made with Macintosh or Granny Smith apples, as they're tart and retain their shape after baking.
ingredients: 1 recipe pastry for a 9 inch double crust pie

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 450 degrees F (230 degrees C).
Peel and slice apples; place slices in a bowl. Add 1 cup white sugar, brown sugar, flour, and cinnamon; toss until apples are evenly coated. Set aside.

Roll out 1 pie crust on a lightly floured work surface; fit into a 10-inch glass pie plate. Pour apple filling into crust; dot with butter. Roll out remaining 1 pie crust; lay over filling. Crimp edges together to seal.
Wet hands with water; dampen top of pie then sprinkle with 1 tablespoon white sugar. Poke some ventilation holes into top crust with a fork so steam can escape.

Bake in the preheated oven for 15 minutes, with a piece of aluminum foil under pie plate to catch overflows. Reduce the oven temperature to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C); continue baking until crust is golden brown, about 45 minutes more. Serve warm.
